description: DevOps baseline: healthcheck /health, pre-commit (ruff+mypy+pytest), bump-version script, devcontainer, GitHub Actions CI/CD su ghcr.io/piccioli/runts, deploy SSH su Hetzner UAT (135.181.25.33) e PROD (178.105.78.67).

userStories.title: Endpoint /health per Docker healthcheck
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a /health endpoint so that Docker can verify the app is running correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Aggiungere route GET /health in web/app.py: esegue SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enti sul DB
Risponde 200 {"status": "ok", "enti": N} se DB raggiungibile e N > 0
Risponde 503 {"status": "error", "detail": "..."} se DB non raggiungibile o N == 0
Aggiungere a docker-compose.yml: healthcheck: test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8000/health"], interval: 30s, timeout: 5s, retries: 3
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: GET /health risponde 200 con JSON {status: ok, enti: N}

userStories.title: pre-commit framework con ruff, ruff-format, mypy, pytest
userStories.description: As a developer, I want automated linting and type checks on every commit so that code quality issues are caught before they reach the repo.
acceptanceCriteria: Creare .pre-commit-config.yaml nella root del progetto con i seguenti hooks in ordine: (1) ruff check --fix, (2) ruff format, (3) mypy su scraper/ e web/, (4) hook locale che esegue python -m pytest scraper/test_sede_legale.py scraper/test_upsert.py -v --tb=short usando il venv .venv/bin/python3
Il vecchio .git/hooks/pre-commit viene sostituito da pre-commit install (documentare nel README)
pre-commit run --all-files passa senza errori sul codebase attuale — se ruff o mypy trovano errori, fixarli prima di committare .pre-commit-config.yaml
Aggiungere pre-commit al requirements-dev.txt (crearlo se non esiste)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: FILE VERSION + scripts/bump-version.sh + CHANGELOG.md
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a version bump script so that I can release new versions with a single command.
acceptanceCriteria: Creare file VERSION nella root con contenuto: 0.1.0

Creare CHANGELOG.md con sezione iniziale: ## [0.1.0] - 2026-06-02

### Note
- Prima release di sviluppo

Creare scripts/bump-version.sh che: accetta argomento major|minor|patch, legge VERSION, incrementa il componente, scrive la nuova versione in VERSION, prepende una nuova sezione in CHANGELOG.md con formato ## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD, esegue git add VERSION CHANGELOG.md && git commit -m 'chore: bump version to vX.Y.Z', crea git tag vX.Y.Z
chmod +x scripts/bump-version.sh
Testare: bash scripts/bump-version.sh patch produce VERSION=0.1.1 e tag v0.1.1 (poi riportare a 0.1.0 con git reset se necessario)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Dev container VS Code (.devcontainer/)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a dev container configuration so that I can start coding in a reproducible environment without manual setup.
acceptanceCriteria: Creare .devcontainer/devcontainer.json con: name=RUNTS-CAI, build.dockerfile=Dockerfile, postCreateCommand che esegue pip install -r scraper/requirements.txt -r web/requirements.txt && pre-commit install && playwright install chromium --with-deps
Creare .devcontainer/Dockerfile basato su python:3.12, installa curl, git, e le dipendenze di sistema per Playwright (libglib2.0, libnss3, ecc.) via apt-get
Aggiungere customizations.vscode.extensions: ms-python.python, charliermarsh.ruff, ms-python.mypy-type-stubs
Aggiungere nota nel README.md nella sezione di setup: 'Dev container disponibile — aprire in VS Code e selezionare Reopen in Container'
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: GitHub Actions CI — lint, test, build su ogni push
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a CI pipeline that runs on every push so that broken code is caught before merge.
acceptanceCriteria: Creare .github/workflows/ci.yml che si attiva su push e pull_request verso qualsiasi branch
Job lint-test: usa ubuntu-latest, python 3.12, installa requirements con pip, esegue pre-commit run --all-files, poi pytest scraper/test_sede_legale.py scraper/test_upsert.py -v
Job build: usa ubuntu-latest, esegue docker build -t runts:test . e verifica che l'immagine parta con docker run --rm runts:test python -c 'import uvicorn; print("ok")'
I due job girano in parallelo (non dipendono l'uno dall'altro)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: GitHub Actions — build e push immagine su ghcr.io/piccioli/runts
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the Docker image pushed to GitHub Container Registry on every merge to develop or prod.
acceptanceCriteria: Creare .github/workflows/publish.yml che si attiva su push ai branch develop e prod
Permissions: contents: read, packages: write
Login su ghcr.io con GITHUB_TOKEN usando docker/login-action@v3
Build e push con docker/build-push-action@v5 con cache (cache-from: type=gha, cache-to: type=gha,mode=max)
Tag per branch develop: ghcr.io/piccioli/runts:develop
Tag per branch prod: ghcr.io/piccioli/runts:latest E ghcr.io/piccioli/runts:v$(cat VERSION) letto dal file VERSION
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: GitHub Actions — deploy automatico su UAT Hetzner
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the UAT server to automatically update when I merge to develop so that testers always have the latest code.
acceptanceCriteria: Creare .github/workflows/deploy-uat.yml che si attiva su workflow_run del workflow publish.yml completato con successo sul branch develop
Usa appleboy/ssh-action@v1 con host: ${{ secrets.UAT_SSH_HOST }}, username: ${{ secrets.UAT_SSH_USER }}, key: ${{ secrets.UAT_SSH_KEY }}
Comando remoto: cd /opt/runts && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d && docker image prune -f
In caso di fallimento SSH il workflow fallisce con exit code non zero
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: GitHub Actions — deploy automatico su PROD Hetzner
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the production server to automatically update when I merge to prod so that releases are zero-touch.
acceptanceCriteria: Creare .github/workflows/deploy-prod.yml che si attiva su workflow_run del workflow publish.yml completato con successo sul branch prod
Usa appleboy/ssh-action@v1 con host: ${{ secrets.PROD_SSH_HOST }}, username: ${{ secrets.PROD_SSH_USER }}, key: ${{ secrets.PROD_SSH_KEY }}
Comando remoto: cd /opt/runts && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d && docker image prune -f
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: docker-compose separati per local, UAT e prod
userStories.description: As a developer, I want separate Docker Compose files for each environment so that each has the right image and settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Rinominare docker-compose.yml in docker-compose.yml (resta il file base locale con build: .)

Creare docker-compose.uat.yml: image: ghcr.io/piccioli/runts:develop, ports: 8000:8000, volumes: /opt/runts/runts.db:/app/runts.db:ro e /opt/runts/attachments:/app/attachments:ro, environment: DB_PATH=/app/runts.db ENV=uat, restart: unless-stopped
Creare docker-compose.prod.yml: image: ghcr.io/piccioli/runts:latest, ports: 8000:8000, volumi identici a uat ma su /opt/runts/, environment: DB_PATH=/app/runts.db ENV=prod, restart: always
Copiare docker-compose.uat.yml sul server UAT: scp docker-compose.uat.yml root@135.181.25.33:/opt/runts/docker-compose.yml
Copiare docker-compose.prod.yml sul server PROD: scp docker-compose.prod.yml root@178.105.78.67:/opt/runts/docker-compose.yml
Aggiornare README con istruzioni: locale (docker compose up), UAT/prod (docker compose -f docker-compose.uat.yml up -d)
Typecheck passes
